hints.title: Leftmost X Greedy Elimination
hints.text: The earliest character X from the left must be converted to O to satisfy the final condition.

hints.title: Three Character Window Skip
hints.text: Whenever character X is encountered at index i, convert indices i, i + 1, and i + 2 in one move and advance index i by three.

hints.title: Linear Greedy Traversal
hints.text: If current character is already O, advance by one. Accumulate the total moves until end of string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N) single linear scan over string of length N
complexity.space: O(1) auxiliary pointer and counter variables
complexity.notes: Greedy jumps skip up to three characters per operation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all conversion permutations is exponential when greedy choice is provably optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Greedy left-to-right elimination uses minimal time and memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize greedy choice property and jump index by 3 upon encountering X.
